<template v-if="language === 'js'">

# Legends

Legends visualize color, opacity, and symbol scales to aid chart interpretation.
Legends can also serve as [interactors](./interactors) that filter or highlight plot content.

Discrete legends update selections with a toggle interaction. Continuous color and opacity legends use an interval brush when their scales support it.
Continuous legends using threshold, quantize, or quantile scales do not support selection interactions.

Use a legend as a directive inside `plot(...)` to include it in the plot.
For a standalone legend, pass `for` with the plot name or its plot element; the function returns a Web element containing the legend.

## colorLegend

`colorLegend(options)`

Create a new legend for a plot's `color` scale.

## opacityLegend

`opacityLegend(options)`

Create a new legend for a plot's `opacity` scale.

## symbolLegend

`symbolLegend(options)`

Create a new legend for a plot's `symbol` scale.


## Options

| Option | Specification type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | `ParamRef` | The output selection. If specified, the legend is interactive, using a toggle interaction for discrete legends or an intervalX interaction for continuous legends. |
| `field` | `string` | The data field over which to generate output selection clauses. If unspecified, a matching field is retrieved from existing plot marks. |
| `label` | `string` | The legend label. |
| `tickSize` | `number` | The size of legend ticks in a continuous legend, in pixels. |
| `marginTop` | `number` | The top margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `marginRight` | `number` | The right margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `marginBottom` | `number` | The bottom margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `marginLeft` | `number` | The left margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `width` | `number` | The width of a continuous legend, in pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | The height of a continuous legend, in pixels. |
| `columns` | `number` | The number of columns to use to layout a discrete legend. |
| `for` | `string` | The name of the plot this legend applies to. A plot must include a name attribute to be referenced. |

`ParamRef` is a `$name` reference in JSON/YAML specifications; JavaScript uses a [Selection](../core/selection) instance for `as`.
Additional options are passed to the [Observable Plot legend method](https://observablehq.com/plot/features/legends#legend-options).

# Legends

Legends visualize color, opacity, and symbol scales to aid chart interpretation.
Legends can also serve as [interactors](./interactors) that filter or highlight plot content.

Discrete legends update selections with a toggle interaction. Continuous color and opacity legends use an interval brush when their scales support it.
Continuous legends using threshold, quantize, or quantile scales do not support selection interactions.

Use a legend inside `vg.plot(...)` to include it in the plot.
For a standalone legend, pass `plot` with the plot name (`for_` is also accepted).
Use `bind` for the output selection (`as_` is also accepted). Other keyword options use snake_case names.
Omitted values and explicit `None` are omitted from the specification. Extra keyword options override named arguments after conversion to specification names.

## color_legend

`vg.color_legend(plot=None, bind=None, label=None, columns=None, **kwargs)`

Create a new legend for a plot's `color` scale.

## opacity_legend

`vg.opacity_legend(plot=None, bind=None, label=None, columns=None, **kwargs)`

Create a new legend for a plot's `opacity` scale.

## symbol_legend

`vg.symbol_legend(plot=None, bind=None, label=None, columns=None, **kwargs)`

Create a new legend for a plot's `symbol` scale.


## Options

| Option | Specification type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | `ParamRef` | The output selection. If specified, the legend is interactive, using a toggle interaction for discrete legends or an intervalX interaction for continuous legends. |
| `field` | `string` | The data field over which to generate output selection clauses. If unspecified, a matching field is retrieved from existing plot marks. |
| `label` | `string` | The legend label. |
| `tick_size` | `number` | The size of legend ticks in a continuous legend, in pixels. |
| `margin_top` | `number` | The top margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `margin_right` | `number` | The right margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `margin_bottom` | `number` | The bottom margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `margin_left` | `number` | The left margin of the legend component, in pixels. |
| `width` | `number` | The width of a continuous legend, in pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | The height of a continuous legend, in pixels. |
| `columns` | `number` | The number of columns to use to layout a discrete legend. |
| `plot` | `string` | The name of the plot this legend applies to. A plot must include a name attribute to be referenced. |

`ParamRef` is a `$name` reference in JSON/YAML specifications; Python accepts a selection definition or a reference for `bind`.

Additional options are passed to the [Observable Plot legend method](https://observablehq.com/plot/features/legends#legend-options).
